claims: JAY-Z will headline the 2026 Roots Picnic with The Roots on May 30, 2026 at Philadelphia's Belmont Plateau.
The Roots will back JAY-Z at the Philadelphia performance.
The 2026 Roots Picnic is on May 30, 2026 (Saturday).
The 2026 Roots Picnic is at Belmont Plateau in Fairmount Park.
The 2026 Roots Picnic is in Philadelphia, PA.
JAY-Z's Reasonable Doubt 30th Anniversary show is on July 10, 2026 at Yankee Stadium.
JAY-Z's The Blueprint 25th Anniversary show is on July 11, 2026 at Yankee Stadium.
Roots Picnic pre-sale is ongoing with code ROOTS26.
Roots Picnic general on-sale starts Wednesday, March 18, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET.
Yankee Stadium shows are announced for July 10-11, 2026 to celebrate album anniversaries.
Ticketing details for Yankee Stadium shows to follow.
The 2026 Roots Picnic and Yankee Stadium shows mark JAY-Z's first live shows since 2018.
